notes_control_model: Side-scroller is the visual format only. User action buttons trigger autonomous Moonbot behaviours; do not add Mario-style movement controls.

terminology_rules.negative_prompt: No tail, no ears, no snout, no animal body, no fur, no paws, no whiskers, no claws.

notes: Side-scroller production queue only. Do not generate, promote, or approve assets automatically.

production_focus.source: Moonbot Side-Scroller Update - Sprite Bible V2
production_focus.stage_usage: Use more horizontal stage travel during autonomous action flows.
production_focus.prop_style: Bold, oversized, readable props that drive action staging and comedy.

items.autonomous_behavior: Moonbot idles in place or makes small side-view breathing/bounce motions until a care/action button is selected.
items.stage_direction: Large readable Moonbot idles near center with subtle rooftop neon motion.
items.prompt: Side-view Moonbot idle animation, white glossy robot companion, chibi cyber mascot, rounded bot body, mitten hands, chunky robot feet, black visor with pink LED eyes, transparent background, no text, no scenery.
items.negative_prompt: No tail, no ears, no snout, no animal body, no fur, no paws, no whiskers, no claws.
